text: Workflow and custom-action results are logged in the ticket's History with the Rule Name, Action Name, Status and Reason; disabled actions are flagged there too.
Zoho has no separate execution-history page for workflow rules.

notes: Item 28 is new. On TAVI the run can only be traced on the Execution History page, by pasting the ticket's record id.
Possible bug to check separately: the same history shows "Department changed — Old blank, New 7e1ac409-…" — the raw department id instead of its name.
Opening the ticket made the app mark it as read for the owner account (the app's own call); nothing else changed. Originals: originals/tavi/tavi-08-ticket-history.png, tavi-09-execution-history.png.
